text:
Anita M: Quick sync — we need to lock the initial onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Goal: legal signoff + publish-ready packaging by next Tue. Can everyone confirm who's owning IAM/certs, branding assets, and the trial bundle?
Diego: I can own publisher setup + infra creds. Need: publisher account email, role ARNs for each cloud, and a staging AMI/container image tag. Also will upload a trial bundle to the marketplace S3. ETA EOD Fri.
Legal - Priya: I’ll handle the publisher agreement + marketplace EULA review. Two asks: localized T&Cs for EU + data residency note for Azure. If you can drop the draft contract in this thread I’ll triage.
Ezra: For eng side — I’ll provision the staging accounts and provide the test endpoints. Will need the role ARNs and a list of IP ranges to whitelist. Staging image tag: redwood-inference/staging:v2026-03-20. AMI: ami-0a12b3c4d5e6f7890 (aws-us-east-1).
Product - Lian: Packaging decision: we should offer a 14-day trial SKU (metered tokens) + a reserved instance SKU. Need final screenshots + two short marketing blurbs (40–60 chars) per cloud. Also confirm whether we include quickstart scripts.
Diego: Putting the initial manifest here (quick snippet):
```
name: redwood-inference
sku: rwinf-trial-14d
bundles:
  - embeddings
  - chat
version: 1.0.0
image: redwood-inference/staging:v2026-03-20
```
Link to trial bundle (private): https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-marketplace/trials/rwinf-trial-14d.tar.gz
Legal - Priya: Quick heads-up — marketplace legal requires a privacy addendum if we surface telemetry. If Ezra can confirm telemetry types (PII? anonymized usage?) that determines a small clause.
Ezra: Telemetry = anonymized metrics + error traces (no user prompt content). Will add a one-line note for the privacy addendum.
Vendors Bot: Reminder — publisher onboarding checklist in Vendor Portal due in 72h. See https://vendor.portal/redwood/checklist
Anita M: Great — Diego + Priya + Ezra confirmed. Lian please send final copy + screenshots by Monday noon. Diego, ping me when manifest uploaded so I can route to marketing for hero assets. Everyone: target publish-by = Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
Product - Lian: Will do. Quick Q — do we want separate trial SKUs per cloud or one cross-cloud SKU? I lean separate (billing hooks differ). Thoughts?
Diego: Separate SKUs simpler for billing reconciliation. +1 from infra.
Legal - Priya: Separate SKUs fine. Will check contract language for multi-cloud entitlements.
Anita M: Ok we’ll go separate. Thanks all — followups as threads to keep this clean.
